title: specklinia macroblepharis
intro: Specklinia macroblepharis, commonly known as the 'Yellow Vanda Orchid', is a species of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its medicinal properties and health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Specklinia macroblepharis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and alleviate symptoms of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
